acceptance.scope: Measured AWQ text inference only; FP8 KV remains experimental. No visual or MTP inference validation.
limitations: Single-GPU experimental Worker and Engine Core RSS grew by about 8.13/8.15 MiB between first and last completed batches; last 20 batches still grew about 1.96 MiB each. Cause not isolated; this is not a no-leak or long-term reliability certification.
One-hour load used short prompts and 512-token outputs; full long-context stress was measured separately.
Capacity maxima apply to the recorded fixed KV budgets and 8192-token resolution, within the native 262144-token limit.
Retrieval tests are single-code lookup tasks; passing does not establish general long-document reasoning accuracy.
